title: Back surgery will keep Robert Kraft from Rob Gronkowski's Patriots Hall of Fame induction

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Back surgery will keep Robert Kraft from Rob Gronkowski's Patriots Hall of Fame induction
sources.description: Patriots owner Robert Kraft recently underwent back surgery, which will keep him sidelined on "injured reserve" and force him to miss Rob Gronkowski's induction into the Patriots Hall of Fame on Saturday.
